```lean
intros f hf a b
have h1 : a - b ≤ a := by exact sub_le_left_iff.1 (le_refl a)
have h2 : f (a - b) ≤ f a := by exact hf h1
have h3 : b ≤ a := by exact le_refl a
have h4 : f b ≤ f a := by exact hf h3
have h5 : f a - f b ≤ f (a - b) := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply add_le_left
  exact h2
exact h5
```
